How we curate Travel Radar

Every Travel Radar entry covers a specific change in border rules, visa policy, or travel advisory that affects real travel decisions. We do not republish press releases or chase clickbait — each article cites at least two authentic sources (government websites, established news outlets) and is dated when the rule was verified.

Travel rules change frequently. We re-verify every Travel Radar article quarterly, but please confirm with the relevant authority before you travel.
